title: JANUS Genesis Sovereign v6.6 — Validate Before Bind, Typed Mutation Receipts, Recovery-Safe Save Import, and Fail-Closed Network Ambiguity
summary: v6.6 audited mutation classes that v6.5 had intentionally left outside the normal process_action receipt path. The resulting descendants validate registration contracts before durable request binding, turn multi-file save import into a recoverable roll-forward saga, replace silent network-state reset/outbox truncation with fail-closed durability and backpressure, and give force-exit/display-name mutations their own typed receipts sharing the canonical local world lock. The default CLI now composes these descendants. The checkpoint remains a cooperating-control claim, not global Python capability security, distributed consensus, or proof of external provider truth.

A24_global_authority_sealing.finding: A caller retaining a raw PlayableGenesisV187 object can bypass cooperating receipt facades.
A24_global_authority_sealing.response: v18.7.39 exposes ControlledGenesisMutationFacade and explicitly labels it a cooperating API construction path rather than a security sandbox.

A25_force_exit_untyped.finding: Default EOF/KeyboardInterrupt force_exit was a direct mutation and could append duplicate exit_forced events if retried blindly.
A25_force_exit_untyped.response: v18.7.39 binds FORCE_EXIT to client/request/actor/reason, stores a full receipt, replays SETTLED without raw re-entry, and blocks stale CALL_ENTERING as UNDETERMINED.

A26_display_name_untyped.finding: Display-name mutation was outside the stable request boundary.
A26_display_name_untyped.response: v18.7.39 adds SET_DISPLAY_NAME typed request/receipt semantics; the default CLI applies the name once through that path.

A27_multi_file_save_import.finding: The historical importer verified the full bundle and made each individual replacement carefully, but the bundle-wide mutation could still stop after only some target replacements.
A27_multi_file_save_import.response: v18.7.37 verifies before mutation, locks cooperating importers, durably stages selected files, records a complete transaction manifest, binds one logical import request to one bundle/policy, and deterministically rolls forward until every selected target has its expected hash.

A28_network_local_and_remote_boundary.finding: Historical local network state lacked a process lock/durable replacement contract and resend after ambiguous remote acceptance was not proved safe.
A28_network_local_and_remote_boundary.response: v18.7.38 uses a durable locked state, persists SEND_ENTERING before POST, requires explicit hash acknowledgements, and blocks automatic resend after ambiguous or partial acknowledgement because hub idempotency remains unverified.

A29_descendant_not_globally_mandatory.finding: Historical raw gateways and world constructors remain instantiable.
A29_descendant_not_globally_mandatory.response: Canonical cooperating construction paths were strengthened without falsely claiming Python-level capability sealing.

A30_production_secret_custody.finding: Reference key-policy metadata is not production secret custody, KMS/HSM integration, or proof of issuer/provider truth.

A31_registration_request_poisoning.finding: Earlier descendants could bind a registration request before parent role/mode validation.
A31_registration_request_poisoning.response: v18.7.36 validates request ID, role, execution mode, actor requirement, and normalized registration contract before any durable registration-request binding.

A32_registration_retry_contract.finding: Recovery after world-before-session-activation currently relies on the tested register_player implementation tolerating the same actor/display replay.

A34_legacy_v25_v27_portability.finding: Historical v18.7.25/v18.7.27 still retain POSIX-only and older SQLite-lifetime assumptions.

A35_corrupt_network_state_reset.finding: Historical _load could interpret malformed/schema-invalid existing state as first run and silently create a fresh node state.
A35_corrupt_network_state_reset.response: v18.7.38 distinguishes missing state from corrupt existing state and fails closed on corruption/schema mismatch.

A36_network_outbox_truncation.finding: Historical queueing silently kept only the newest 1024 outbox entries.
A36_network_outbox_truncation.response: v18.7.38 turns capacity into explicit backpressure; event 1025 is rejected while the oldest unsent event is preserved.

A37_double_name_owner.finding: The interactive CLI applied --name in main and again in play, proving the mutation lacked one clear owner.
A37_double_name_owner.response: main owns the one typed name mutation; play no longer writes it.
